answer:

**Current price (July 18, 2026):** ~$0.0034–0.0036 USD (24h range $0.003078–$0.003640; the July 18 daily candle hadn't closed yet). Most recent completed daily close was **July 17 = $0.00324010**.

**Key context:**
- TAC hit an all-time high of ~$0.067 on June 30, 2026, then crashed ~90% in early July when 18 wallets dumped ~372M TAC around a Binance listing — this is why the July 11–14 closes are all in the low-$0.003 range.
- The dates show a downtrend (Jul 11 → Jul 13) then a small bounce on Jul 14.

**Important caveat:** Coinbase displayed a stale/incorrect price of $0.01644, but CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, CoinStats, and Crypto.com all agree on the ~$0.003 range. I used the CoinGecko-sourced values as authoritative for this question.
